title: rewards.stamp.removed v1
description: A purchase stamp was taken back (full refund or cancellation). Source: alebrije-mod-rewards-go (ADR-186 D19.4 / D19.7), written to the rewards outbox in the SAME transaction as the ledger row (internal/service/stamps.go emitStampEvent) and relayed to the enveloped events:rewards stream. Emitted only when the site's CONTRATO-v1 §6 data.messaging allows the notice (allowed and pieces["rewards.stamps"]). rewards sends no message itself: each tenant's cadences/notifications rule decides (ADR-152). contact_id / contact_phone are the member's CRM contact and canonical phone (ADR-142), present when known.

amount.description: Stamps counted toward the card after this event.

reason.description: removed: refunded or cancelled; reward_pending_email: no_email.

reference.description: The order id, when the event has one.

site_id.description: CONTRATO-v1 §6 site id: the store of the order. A card event names the store where the reward coupon is valid.

order_id.description: The WooCommerce order of the stamp (absent on card events that come from the sweep).

stamps.description: Stamps counted toward the open card.

stamps_goal.description: Stamps the card needs (the tenant's rule); 0 on events that do not carry the rule (removed).

reward_kind.description: Empty on events that do not carry the rule (removed).

reward_value.description: Decimal text (D17.3); empty on events that do not carry the rule (removed).

metadata.description: Datos del sello: tarjeta, regla, pedido y sitio que lo originaron.
